text: 📢 Meet Qwen4-Max, your new AI teammate for work, creativity, and discovery! Qwen4-Max is built on a new MoE architecture with native vision and a 1M-token context window. Highlights: - Outperforms Qwen3.8-Max with up to ~50% fewer tokens, while average cost per task drops over 60% in our internal evaluation. - Advances real-world productivity through greater proficiency with professional tools, stronger long-horizon execution, and higher-quality deliverables. - Handles real tasks, including 3D modeling, game development, manufacturing, finance, law, healthcare, and frontier scientific discovery. - $1.5/M tokens for input, $4.5/M tokens for output, and $0.075/M tokens for implicit caching — all lower than Qwen3.8-Max, with implicit caching down by 70%. The API is live on QwenCloud. You can also try Qwen4-Max on Qwen Studio, QwenWork and Qoder.
